This is powerful stuff. I have used it once a week or less for the last year. Only because I wasn't sure if it did anything at all. Last week I decided to use it for a few days in a row and wow, I had a very surprising reaction. I noticed my forehead was starting to flake and around my eyes even though I didn't put it on my eyes. Long story short, I got out of the shower on the 4th day and went to apply my normal Lancer Nourish and my skin was on fire. Like acid. I washed it off but I couldn't use any of my moisturizing for about 4-5 days since it would burn. I think for me, my skin is sensitive to it, but I know, if I am careful and only use it occasionally, it is probably doing a lot of good work. I've used Lancer products for about 15+ years and never had an experience like this. Use with care until you know how it reacts.
